import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split, GridSearchCV
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data
input_dir = "input"
train_path = f"{input_dir}/train.csv"
test_path = f"{input_dir}/test.csv"
sample_submission_path = f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv"

train_df = pd.read_csv(train_path)
test_df = pd.read_csv(test_path)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(sample_submission_path)

print(f"Training samples: {len(train_df)}, Test samples: {len(test_df)}")

# Define columns to predict
labels = ["toxic", "severe_toxic", "obscene", "threat", "insult", "identity_hate"]

# Clean comment texts
comment_texts_train = (
    train_df["comment_text"].fillna("").str.strip().values.astype(object)
)
comment_texts_test = test_df["comment_text"].fillna("").str.strip()

# Split BEFORE vectorization
X_train_split, X_val, y_train_split, y_val = train_test_split(
    comment_texts_train,
    train_df[labels].values,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df[labels],  # Stratified split to handle imbalanced classes
)

# Apply TF-IDF vectorizer to TRAINING split ONLY
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    max_features=50000,
    min_df=5,
    stop_words="english",
    lowercase=True,
)

X_train_final = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train_split)
X_val_final = vectorizer.transform(X_val)

# Train models for each label with hyperparameter tuning
models = {}

for i, label in enumerate(labels):
    y_target = y_train_split[:, i]

    # Grid search over C values
    param_grid = {"C": [0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 5.0, 10.0]}
    clf = LogisticRegression(class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000)

    grid_search = GridSearchCV(clf, param_grid, cv=5, scoring="roc_auc", n_jobs=-1)
    grid_search.fit(X_train_final, y_target)

    best_params = grid_search.best_params_
    print(
        f"{label}: Best C = {best_params['C']}, Score = {grid_search.best_score_:.4f}"
    )

    # Retrain with best parameters
    clf_optimal = LogisticRegression(
        class_weight="balanced", max_iter=1000, C=best_params["C"], solver="lbfgs"
    )
    clf_optimal.fit(X_train_final, y_target)
    models[label] = clf_optimal

# Transform validation data for scoring (using CORRECT indexing: y_val[:, i])
val_scores = []
for i, label in enumerate(labels):
    val_pred_proba = models[label].predict_proba(X_val_final)[:, 1]
    y_true = y_val[:, i]
    auc = roc_auc_score(y_true, val_pred_proba)
    val_scores.append(auc)
    print(f"{label}: Validation Column-wise ROC AUC = {auc:.4f}")

mean_auc = np.mean(val_scores)
print(f"\nMean Column-wise ROC AUC = {mean_auc:.4f}")

# Transform test data for predictions
X_test = vectorizer.transform(comment_texts_test)

# Predict probabilities for all labels
test_predictions = {}
for label in labels:
    test_pred_proba = models[label].predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
    test_predictions[label] = test_pred_proba

# Create submission file in the correct location
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "id": test_df["id"],
        "toxic": test_predictions["toxic"],
        "severe_toxic": test_predictions["severe_toxic"],
        "obscene": test_predictions["obscene"],
        "threat": test_predictions["threat"],
        "insult": test_predictions["insult"],
        "identity_hate": test_predictions["identity_hate"],
    }
)

os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("\nSubmission saved to submission/submission.csv")
